objective: Define the CPU-visible control contract for kicking the selected MobileViT-S reference path without claiming implementation or accuracy.

selected_model.input_contract: ImageNet-style preprocessed 256x256 BGR tensor or a raw image pointer plus preprocessing mode, depending on the first implementation path.

mmio_register_contract.name: MODEL_ID
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Identifies the selected MobileViT-S reference model.

mmio_register_contract.name: COMMAND
mmio_register_contract.purpose: CPU writes LOAD_MODEL, LOAD_IMAGE, KICK_INFER, or CLEAR_STATUS.

mmio_register_contract.name: STATUS
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Reports idle, busy, done, dependency_blocked, data_error, or model_error.

mmio_register_contract.name: IMAGE_ADDR_LO
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Low 32 bits of image or tensor input address.

mmio_register_contract.name: IMAGE_ADDR_HI
mmio_register_contract.purpose: High 32 bits of image or tensor input address.

mmio_register_contract.name: IMAGE_BYTES
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Input byte length for manifest and bounds checking.

mmio_register_contract.name: PREPROCESS_MODE
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Selects raw-image preprocessing or already-normalized tensor input.

mmio_register_contract.name: RESULT_TOP1_CLASS
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Top-1 ImageNet class index from the most recent inference.

mmio_register_contract.name: RESULT_TOP1_SCORE_Q16
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Quantized top-1 score or probability proxy for deterministic comparison.

mmio_register_contract.name: RESULT_TOP5_MASK_OR_BASE
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Top-5 result summary; exact encoding must be fixed by the first implementation.

mmio_register_contract.name: IMAGE_INDEX
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Manifest image index used for accuracy accounting.

mmio_register_contract.name: EXPECTED_LABEL
mmio_register_contract.purpose: Ground-truth ImageNet label for smoke and accuracy comparison.

first_implementation_options.name: host_proxy_reference_inference
first_implementation_options.description: CPU MMIO kick drives a host-side MobileViT reference runner first, producing top-k result words before any RTL ViT datapath claim.

first_implementation_options.name: rtl_proxy_stub_then_reference_compare
first_implementation_options.description: A deterministic RTL proxy emits manifest-bound class outputs for smoke tests while a CPU reference runner validates labels separately.

first_implementation_options.name: future_rtl_datapath
first_implementation_options.description: Replace proxy execution with RTL datapath only after model/data/reference flow is reproducible.

non_claims: not implemented in RTL or host runtime
